instruction_lines: INSTRUCTION: For each line, compare the original BOM description to the scraped LCSC product. Confirm they match; if not, flag it. OUTPUT: Only the flagged items (or no flagged items confirmation) and reason.
DO NOT FLAG: Higher capacitor voltage than specified is OK. Higher wattage than specified is OK.
CONTEXT: A line may end with // followed by project notes. Notes may override problems: do not flag a difference explicitly accepted by the notes. Lines without notes omit // entirely.
